digest.component_or_area: rebar core infrastructure (retry wrapper, eval runner, metrics registry)
propositions: timeout_s parameter in _call_with_retry signature is accepted but never read, and intercepts intended timeout values meant for downstream Jira client via **kwargs
run_eval(dirty=) parameter is declared but never read; no caller passes it and it falsely implies eval-provenance source switching capability
module_size_trend and commit_cadence_trend metric specs are permanently unavailable and will silently block future real implementations due to id collision in registrar append logic

Deleting timeout_s restores natural **kwargs forwarding so caller-supplied timeout values reach fn; deleting dirty parameter removes false capability signal; deleting unavailable metric stubs frees ids and prevents silent registration collision
